en.name: Stayframe
en.seo_title: Stayframe | Rental Inspection, Move-In Reports & Move-Out Comparison
en.summary: Record rental inspections on iPhone, compare move-in and move-out conditions, and share a room-by-room PDF or image report with your landlord.

zh.name: Stayframe
zh.seo_title: Stayframe 租房验房 App｜入住报告、退租房况对比
zh.summary: 用 iPhone 逐间记录租房入住和退租房况，对照照片与备注，导出 PDF 或图片验房报告与房东沟通。

en.name: Foliover: Photos & Space
en.tagline: Photo cleanup, image tools & calendar cleanup
en.summary: Review duplicate photos and unwanted calendar events, add timestamps, compress images, and prepare photos for printing.
features: Review duplicate and similar photos, screenshots, large files and videos before removal.
Add a timestamp to a copy, replace a portrait background, or prepare a print sheet. Resize, compress and convert images.
Review invitations, duplicate events and subscriptions before calendar cleanup. Photo and calendar analysis run on your device.

zh.name: Foliover：照片与空间
zh.tagline: 照片清理、图片工具与日历清理
zh.summary: 整理重复照片和不需要的日历事件，也能为照片添加时间戳、压缩图片或制作打印排版。
features: 在移除前检查重复和相似照片、截图、大文件和视频。
给照片副本加时间戳、更换人像背景或制作打印排版，也可以调整尺寸、压缩和转换格式。
清理日历前查看邀请、重复事件和订阅。照片与日历分析均在本机完成。

en.name: Trio: Daily Logic Puzzles
en.tagline: Three daily puzzles with unique solutions
en.summary: Draw a path, balance suns and moons, and place crowns. Everyone gets the same three logic puzzles each day.
features: Trace visits every numbered cell with a single path. Lumen balances suns and moons. Crowns places one crown per row, column and region.
Every puzzle has exactly one solution. Track streaks and solve times, and compare shareable results with friends.
Play the daily puzzles offline. Optional Pro access expands practice, hints and the archive.

zh.name: Trio：每日逻辑谜题
zh.tagline: 每天三道题，每题只有一个解
zh.summary: 一笔连路径、平衡太阳和月亮、在棋盘上摆放皇冠。每天三道新题，全球同题。
features: Trace 一笔走过编号格，Lumen 平衡太阳和月亮，Crowns 在每行、每列和每个色块区域放置一顶皇冠。
每题验证唯一解。记录连胜和解题用时，和朋友分享成绩。
每日谜题可以离线玩。可选的 Pro 解锁更多练习、提示和往期题目。

en.name: Knots: Connect Puzzle
en.summary: Connect matching dots without crossing paths and fill the grid for a Perfect result. Play without a timer.
features: Work through 999 levels on grids from 5 × 5 to 12 × 12.
Try a new daily challenge or pick up a level offline. Gentle hints help when you get stuck.
The optional one-time Pro unlock includes all levels, unlimited hints and Endless Mode.

zh.name: Knots: Connect Puzzle
zh.tagline: 没有计时的同色连线谜题
zh.summary: 连接同色圆点，让线路互不交叉。铺满整个棋盘即可获得完美成绩。
features: 探索 999 个关卡，棋盘从 5 × 5 到 12 × 12。
挑战每日谜题，或离线玩任意已解锁关卡。遇到困难时可以使用提示。
可选的一次性 Pro 解锁包含全部关卡、无限提示和无尽模式。

en.name: Eos: Disk Cleanup
en.seo_title: Eos | Free Mac Disk Cleanup, Xcode Caches & Duplicate File Finder
en.summary: Find what takes up space on your Mac. Review Xcode caches, exact duplicates, large files and app leftovers before cleanup. Free and on-device.

zh.name: Eos：磁盘清理
zh.seo_title: Eos 免费 Mac 磁盘清理｜Xcode 缓存、重复文件与应用卸载
zh.summary: 免费查看 Mac 磁盘占用，查找 Xcode 缓存、大文件、完全重复的文件与应用残留。在本机扫描，复核后再清理。

en.name: Scentory: Perfume Samples
en.summary: Keep track of samples and where you put them. Log how a fragrance changes and decide whether to buy, retry or pass.
features: Group samples into boxes, mark sample positions on a photo, and browse the bundled perfume catalog offline.
Record first impressions and later observations in one trial, with scent tags, notes and optional local reminders.
Review your decisions and trial history. Export a JSON backup or enable optional private iCloud sync.

zh.name: Scentory：香水小样与试香笔记
zh.tagline: 小样收纳、试香感受与购买决定
zh.summary: 记住每支小样放在哪里、香气怎样变化，以及下一步要买正装、再试还是放弃。
features: 用样盒整理小样，在自己的盒子照片上标注位置，离线浏览内置香水目录。
把初闻和后续感受归入同一次试香，添加标签、笔记和可选提醒。
回看试香记录与决定历程，导出 JSON 备份，或开启可选的私人 iCloud 同步。

en.name: Daily Quest: Habit & Goals
en.summary: Check off recurring habits, advance goals step by step, and watch Mochi and its world grow.
features: Schedule recurring habits daily, on selected weekdays or every few days.
Create a goal expedition with a target and deadline. Review streaks, calendars and achievements.
Use local reminders and Live Activities to see your progress. Habit records stay on your device.

zh.name: 每日任务：习惯与目标打卡
zh.summary: 完成日常习惯，一步步推进目标，看 Mochi 和它的世界随进度成长。
features: 为重复习惯选择每天、指定星期或每隔几天的频率。
设立带目标次数和截止日期的探险，并查看连胜、日历和成就。
通过本地提醒和实时活动查看进度，打卡记录保存在本机。

en.name: HomeCue: Receipts & Care
en.summary: Keep receipts and warranties with the things you own, track return deadlines, and schedule home and car maintenance.
features: Start from 48 illustrated item templates and plan maintenance by date, mileage, or whichever comes first.
Scan receipts, read text on-device, link one receipt to multiple items, and track item-level returns.
Keep service history and attachments, export proof as a PDF, or make a complete local backup.

zh.name: HomeCue：物品维护与收据管理
zh.tagline: 家庭维护、退货提醒与保修记录
zh.summary: 把收据和保修资料归到对应物品，记录退货截止日，并安排家居和车辆维护。
features: 从 48 个插画模板选择物品，按日期、里程或先到条件安排维护。
扫描多页收据，在本机识别文字，把同一张收据关联到多件物品并记录逐件退货。
保留维护记录和附件，可导出 PDF 凭证或完整本地备份。

en.name: Family & Friends Journal
en.tagline: Private people journal with birthday reminders
en.summary: Give each person a private place for photos, memories, birthdays and important documents.
features: Create profiles with relationship tags, personal details, photos, videos and Live Photos.
Record Gregorian and lunar birthdays, set local reminders, and add dates to Apple Calendar when you choose.
Scan or import important documents and file them by person. Keep selected profiles behind a private-record password.

zh.name: Family & Friends Journal
zh.tagline: 亲友相册、生日提醒与私人档案
zh.summary: 为每位亲友建立独立档案，保存照片、回忆、生日和重要文件。
features: 为人物建立档案，保存关系标签、个人资料、照片、视频和实况照片。
记录公历和农历生日，设置本地提醒，按需添加到 Apple 日历。
扫描或导入重要文件，并按人物归档。指定人物档案可用密码保护。

en.name: IDMint: Passport Photo Maker
en.seo_title: IDMint Passport & ID Photo Maker for iPhone | U.S., UK, Canada & Europe
en.summary: Make passport, visa and ID photos on iPhone with size guides for the U.S., UK, Canada and Europe. Crop privately and export a JPEG, PNG or 4 × 6 print sheet.

zh.name: IDMint：护照与证件照制作
zh.seo_title: IDMint 护照与证件照制作 App｜美国、英国、加拿大与欧洲尺寸
zh.summary: 在 iPhone 上制作护照、签证和身份证照片，查看美国、英国、加拿大与欧洲多地尺寸。本机裁剪，可导出 JPEG、PNG 或 4 × 6 英寸打印排版。

en.name: Dewday: Daily Savings
en.summary: Log spending choices, record purchases you skipped, and grow a virtual plant as you build a savings habit.
features: Check in each day as no spending, essentials only, or other spending, and track streaks in a calendar.
Set a seven-day, monthly or yearly challenge with your own daily amount and reward.
Track estimates and share progress cards. Dewday works without connecting to a bank.

zh.name: Dewday：每日省钱与存钱挑战
zh.tagline: 不花钱打卡与存钱挑战
zh.summary: 记录每日花费和忍住没买的东西，养成省钱习惯，同时看虚拟植物慢慢长大。
features: 按不花钱、仅必需支出或其他支出打卡，在日历回看记录和连胜。
设置 7 天、一个月或一年的挑战，自定每日金额和完成奖励。
查看省钱估算并分享进度卡片，使用时无需连接银行账户。
